column1: # f14 drifts .pi's own copy, and that copy is a link into .agents/skills: an
# append would land on the file every tree shares and drift none of them apart.
# cp -p then mv gives .pi the file itself, byte for byte, before the append.
# find -L, because grep's own recursion skips the links .claude carries into
# .agents/skills and the literals live in files on both sides of that line.

column3: perl -pi -e 's/^## 9\. Project Runtime$/## 9. Project Runtime Environment/' "$W/AGENTS.md"
